name: Tweak Loader
tagline: 在 iOS 18“设置”首页集中查看插件设置与常用设备信息。
description: Tweak Loader 在 iOS 18“设置”首页提供统一插件入口，可集中查看并打开已安装插件的设置页面。
主页还可按需显示局域网 IP、存储占用、电池健康及密码生成入口。
features: 集中查看已安装插件的设置页面
直接打开兼容的插件设置面板
显示局域网 IP、存储占用与电池健康
自定义入口名称及主页显示项目
usage: 点击插件入口查看并打开已安装插件的设置页面。
在列表底部的设置中调整入口名称和主页显示项目。

changes: 修复复杂网络环境下可能显示错误 IP 地址的问题。
修复部分插件名称未跟随系统语言显示的问题。
增强插件列表与设置主页信息的显示体验。

en.name: Tweak Loader
en.tagline: Access tweak settings and useful device information from the iOS 18 Settings home screen.
description: Tweak Loader adds a unified entry to the iOS 18 Settings home screen for viewing and opening installed tweak preference panes.
It can also show the local IP address, storage usage, battery health, and a password generator.
features: View installed tweak preference panes in one place
Show local IP address, storage usage, and battery health
Customize the entry name and visible information rows
usage: Open the system Settings app after installation.
Tap the tweaks entry to view and open installed preference panes.
Use Settings at the bottom of the list to customize the entry name and visible information rows.

changes: Fixed incorrect IP address selection on complex network configurations.
Fixed some tweak names not following the system language.
Improved the tweak list and Settings home information display.
